Resolves #21381

A chip field's clear and dropdown triggers stay at its end when its chips wrap. The value list and the input now share one wrapping flow node inside the input wrapper, which no longer wraps itself, so a trigger never starts a row of its own.

Intake: self-authored this session. Prescription checked: `src/form/field/Chip.mjs` owns the concern. It is the only field whose input row wraps, and `insertValueListVdom()` already placed the value list and re-runs after every trigger rebuild.

Evidence: L3 (component specs in Chromium, red on `dev` and green at head; headless crops of the example at 270 px, before and after) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-3, AC-5). Residual: AC-6, Residual-Owner: #21333.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/component/form/field/Chip.spec.mjs` › "once the chips and the input fill the row, the triggers stay at its end rather than wrap". The field narrows to its value list + 4 + 80 + 10 px, room for the input's 80 px basis but not the triggers. The dropdown trigger then starts right of every chip and the input, and ends at the wrapper's inner end. Narrower still: "narrower than the input's 80 px, the input shrinks and stays clear of the triggers", at 100 px with no chip and with one. At `5d915baea5` the input ran 12 px under the dropdown trigger. |
| AC-2 | Outside-CI: the default 300 px example on `neo-theme-light`, at 1440 × 900, measures 300 × 36 px at head, its input at `[507, 468, 80, 25]` and its triggers at `[591, 468, 1, 25]` and `[596, 468, 22, 25]`: the same rects as with `dev`'s `Chip.mjs` and `Chip.css` swapped in. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: "a trigger change rebuilds the input wrapper and keeps the chips and the input in one flow". `clearable: false` drops a trigger, and the flow node still holds the value list, then the input. Outside-CI mutation: without the re-insertion in `afterSetTriggers()`, this test fails. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: the spec's keyboard, pointer, picker and Backspace tests and `ComboBox.spec.mjs` pass at head (19 of 19); `test/playwright/unit/form/field/Chip.spec.mjs` and `ComboBoxSharedStore.spec.mjs` pass (30 of 30). |
| AC-5 | CI-covered at head. Outside-CI on `origin/dev`'s `Chip.mjs` and `Chip.css`: the AC-1 test fails with the trigger starting at 28 px against a flow ending at 233 px. |
| AC-6 | Post-merge: the `form-field-chip` tile is recaptured with #21333. |

## Deltas from ticket

- The theme test in the same spec read the input wrapper's `flex-wrap: wrap`. It now reads `wrap` on the flow node and `nowrap` on the wrapper.
- The input's minimum width is 0 instead of 80 px. Its 80 px flex basis still decides when it wraps under the chips, so the minimum only acts on an input alone on a flow line narrower than that. At the example's 50 px floor the two triggers fill the 40 px inside the wrapper and the flow is 0 px wide: with a chip, the input's 12 px of padding overlaps the clear trigger by 8 px. No layout fits a chip at that width.
